visual.name: plumeCandleChart
visual.description: Candlestick (OHLC) chart with the Plume Studio look: candles, hollow candles, OHLC bars, line and area; no weekend gaps; built-in timeframes from 1 minute to 1 year; volume pane; moving averages, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD and 60+ technical indicators computed in the visual; crosshair legend, zoom and range buttons; event annotations; long and short positions with profit, risk/reward and statistics.
